decision: Use Elden Ring as the first major source target, Nightreign as a source and transformation reference, and potentially Diablo II as additional design material.
arpg_direction: Explore different combat, loot, progression and session structures; no final camera, engine, campaign or rules selected.

targets.edition: select compatible stable edition when admitted

milestones.result: Pin build, runtime, test profile and dependencies; reproduce unchanged declared movement/combat/death/save-load cases in a separate admitted environment.
Explain one selected encounter from observed combat and related parameter, event and asset records, retaining unanswered questions.
Apply one declared reversible encounter or progression difference; evaluate the intended difference and preserved baseline behavior.
Produce and evaluate a coherent expedition, dungeon campaign or loot-focused prototype after Bdo chooses the first direction.

measurement_candidates.name: launch and recovery
measurement_candidates.method: Actual process identity, rendered scene, profile write locations, stop, fresh restore and repeat

measurement_candidates.name: combat outcomes
measurement_candidates.method: Fixed attacker/target/build and input sequence; record damage, resource use, death and timing with declared tolerances

measurement_candidates.name: encounter pacing
measurement_candidates.method: Compare completion time, deaths and encounter choices across repeated declared cases

measurement_candidates.name: loot and progression
measurement_candidates.method: Record reward distribution, build choices and persistence across a declared sample; distinguish RNG variation from regressions

measurement_candidates.name: player judgment
measurement_candidates.method: Bdo evaluates control feel, clarity, challenge and desire to continue; automated checks retain technical evidence separately

limits: This record is a project brief, not observed game behavior or a REA-SON knowledge graph.
Elden Ring and Nightreign have no implemented Nostalgia native gameplay provider yet.
Downloaded file presence does not establish complete installation, compatibility, isolation or a runnable baseline.
